		Model Pulse data
	

A daily time series of the whole Hugging Face Hub. Downloads and likes for every actively used model and dataset, and likes for every liked Space, one row per repo per day since 2024-07-29, refreshed every day.
It is the data behind Model Pulse, which has a page with the full history of every model, dataset and Space, along with model families (quantizations, fine-tunes… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/modelpulse/model-pulse-data.
